Plugin.Name: Fabric Routing
Plugin.Overview: WIP — FRRouting packages for Unraid (zebra, fabricd/OpenFabric). Primary focus: pairing with Thunderbolt Net for OpenFabric on the Thunderbolt underlay. Settings → Network Settings → Fabric Routing: Download and Install packages. Does not change eth0/br0 by default. Broader Ethernet fabric support later. Support: Thunderbolt Net forum thread for now.
